thread:
Devon Park: Quick sync — proposing a 2-day Enablement Hackday for new SI partners in Q2. Hands-on labs + a lightweight cert at the end. Goal: get partner engineers listing on marketplace by week 2. Thoughts? :sparkles:
Maria Chen: love it. how many partner teams are we targeting? and do we already have trainers?
Kevin O'Leary: recommend cap at 6 SI teams per cohort (keeps mentor ratio 1:3). trainers: me + Aj + 1 partner engineer. will need a test harness and scoring rubric.
Sylvia Ramos: shipping note — hardware partner can ship 10 kits across NA/EU if we finalize SKUs this week. need customs paperwork for APAC (longer lead).
Aj Patel: I can prep a lightweight sandbox image and an infra quickstart. will push a repo skeleton today: https://github.com/redwood-inference/si-hackday
Devon Park: perfect. logistics checklist (draft):
- cohort size: 6 teams
- duration: 2 days (9am-5pm local)
- prework: 2 simple labs (env + small inference test)
- day1: infra + hw setup + quick integration
- day2: end-to-end app + marketplace listing exercise + cert practical
- post: 2-week office hours + certification verification
Maria Chen: can we fold in marketplace listing onboarding as a mandatory lab? it's a big win for partners.
Kevin O'Leary: yes — lab will include creating a listing metadata, bundling model variant, and verifying routing. allocate 90m for that.
Sylvia Ramos: shipping timeline if SKUs approved by Fri:
- NA kits: ship Mon next week (2-day transit)
- EU kits: ship Wed (4-6 day transit)
- APAC: need invoice + customs (2-3 weeks)
Devon Park: action items: Maria to coordinate partner invites, Sylvia to confirm kit SKUs and ETA, Aj to seed repo + quickstart docs, Kevin to draft scoring rubric. I'll book a planning call.
partner-bot: Devon Park scheduled a meeting: "Enablement Hackday planning" Thu 10:30am PT — link: https://calendar.redwood.com/event/enablement-hackday
Maria Chen: volunteers for mentoring? @Kevin O'Leary, @Aj Patel, @Sasha (would you join?)
Kevin O'Leary: can take lead on the grading rubric and marketplace lab. will draft and post by Tue.
Aj Patel: I'll add a 2-step prework script and a docker image. example start command:
```
docker run --rm -p 8080:8080 ghcr.io/redwood-inference/si-lab:latest ./start-lab.sh
```
Sylvia Ramos: FYI — I'll put a short shipping FAQ in the repo (customs, serial numbers, return labels).
Devon Park: one more ask — legal wants a short MOU template for partner commitments (attendance, feedstock for certs). Maria can you loop in legal?
Maria Chen: will do, looping @legal now.
Kevin O'Leary: proposal: certify folks with a pass/fail practical (30–45m) + badge. keep it lightweight — certificate issuance automated via a small form post.
Devon Park: great. target pilot cohort date: 2026-06-15 — does that work for shipping and docs?
Sylvia Ramos: NA/EU yes, APAC not for pilot.
Maria Chen: I'll start outreach to 8 candidate SIs and confirm 6 by EOD Fri.
Devon Park: awesome — thanks team. I'll drop a concise one-pager and planning board after the call. :thumbsup:
